gloss: following the road; along the road

definitions.gloss: following the road; along the road; as the road goes
definitions.explanation: Following the natural course of a road without turning off. Very common in giving and receiving directions.

examples.japanese: {道|みち}なり⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{進|すす}んで→進む：01225_susumu⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please go straight along the road.
If you follow this road, you'll reach the station.

examples.japanese: ⟦{信号|しんごう}→信号：03258_shingou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{過|す}ぎたら→過ぎる：01219_sugiru⟧{道|みち}なり⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{右|みぎ}→右：02257_migi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦カーブ→カーブ：27529_kaabu⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧、⟦{二|ふた}つ{目|め}→二つ目：30351_futatsume⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{角|かど}→角：02195_kado⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{左|ひだり}→左：00628_hidari⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{曲|ま}がって→曲がる：00649_magaru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: After passing the traffic light, follow the road as it curves right, then turn left at the second corner.

notes:
USAGE:
{道|みち}なり combines ⟦{道|みち}→道：00505_michi⟧ (road) and ⟦なり→なり：09883_nari⟧ (as it is, following). It is almost always used with the particle ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ ({道|みち}なり⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧) to mean "following the road." This is an essential expression for giving and understanding directions in Japanese.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {道|みち}なり⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{進|すす}む→進む：01225_susumu⟧ (to proceed along the road)
- {道|みち}なり⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}く→行く：00119_iku⟧ (to go along the road)
- {道|みち}なり⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{歩|ある}く→歩く：00538_aruku⟧ (to walk along the road)

SIMILAR WORDS:
⟦まっすぐ→まっすぐ：00866_massugu⟧ means straight ahead, while {道|みち}なり means following the road even if it curves. When a road curves, {道|みち}なり⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ means to follow the curve rather than going straight off the road.
